subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does the security/CI ownership group approve replacing these executable action commits, including the Codex permission-model update, once the branch is rebased and exact-head gates pass?
rationale: These actions execute with write tokens, private keys, registry credentials, and API keys, while repository policy assigns several touched workflows to security CODEOWNERS and requires direct Codex-source verification.

options.title: Approve after security verification
options.body: Review the upstream commit provenance and Codex contract, rebase the branch, and merge only after the relevant exact-head security and CI gates pass.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, CodeQL, and release-action updates from routine setup-action pins if the combined security review is too broad.

options.title: Pause unresolved pins
options.body: Leave any action with unclear upstream behavior at its current immutable commit and update only the independently verified families.

recommendation.title: Approve after security verification
recommendation.body: Review the upstream commit provenance and Codex contract, rebase the branch, and merge only after the relevant exact-head security and CI gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNER for multiple security-sensitive workflows changed by the PR.
